data: Which interactions are represented in the figure?

The figure shows four different types of interactions between Nigerian entities. The red lines represent the geodesic distance between two entities, while the blue dots represent the number of interactions between two entities (relative degree) at each timestamp. The blue lines are the regression of the relative degree between two entities over time. The interactions shown in the figure are:

1. Citizen (Nigeria) - Government (Nigeria)
2. Citizen (Nigeria) - Ministry (Nigeria)
3. Government (Nigeria) - Other Authorities (Nigeria)
4. Government (Nigeria) - Ministry (Nigeria)

These interactions are represented in the figure through the use of different subfigures and the corresponding labels.
